grammarFocus: 原因、结果与让步从句；may / might / can 的语气差别。
title: The Community Garden Meeting
instructions: 这是一份模拟的英语听力练习，适合B1–B2水平的学习者。请先听录音（或阅读录音文本），然后回答10个问题。问题类型包括单选题、填空题和判断题（True/False/Not Given）。填空题的答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过规定的字数。所有解释均为中文，并附有原文证据。
transcript:
M: Hi everyone, thanks for coming to the community garden meeting. I know it's a busy time, so let's start. First, the good news: we've received a small grant from the city to buy new tools and seeds. (1) Because the grant is only for one year, we need to decide how to spend it wisely. Any ideas?

W: Yes, I think we should buy a shed to store the tools. (2) If we don't have a shed, the tools will get rusty in the rain. Also, a shed can be used for meetings when the weather is bad.

M: That's a good point. But a shed might be expensive. (3) We may not have enough money for both a shed and new seeds. What do others think?

W2: I agree with the shed idea, but maybe we can build it ourselves to save money. (4) Although none of us are professional builders, we can watch online videos and learn. My neighbour built his own shed last year, and it looks fine.

M: OK, so we could build a shed. But we also need to think about the seeds. (5) Since we want to grow vegetables for the food bank, we should buy seeds that are easy to grow, like beans and carrots.

W: Right. And (6) even though beans are cheap, they need support to climb, so we might need to buy sticks or nets. That could add to the cost.

M: True. Let's not forget the water problem. (7) The tap is far from the garden, so we have to carry water in buckets. That's hard work for older members. Could we use some money for a water tank?

W2: A water tank would be great, but (8) unless we get permission from the council, we can't put a large tank there. The council might say no because of safety rules.

M: Hmm. So we have three possible things: a shed, seeds, and a water tank. (9) We can't afford all three, so we need to prioritise. Let's vote next week. But before that, does anyone have other ideas?

W: What about asking local businesses for donations? (10) If we explain our plan clearly, they might give us materials for free. For example, a hardware store could donate wood for the shed.

M: That's a clever idea. OK, so let's summarise: we'll ask for donations, and then decide between the shed, seeds, and water tank. Thanks for your time. Let's meet again next Tuesday.

grammar.title: 原因、结果与让步从句；may / might / can 的语气差别
grammar.explanation: 原因从句常用 because, since, as 引导，说明原因；结果从句常用 so 引导，说明结果；让步从句常用 although, even though, unless 引导，表示“虽然/除非”。may 表示“可能”或“可以”，语气较正式；might 表示“可能”，但可能性比 may 稍低或更不确定；can 表示“能够”或“可以”，语气较直接。
grammar.example: Because the grant is only for one year, we need to decide how to spend it wisely.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: ___ it rains, we will still work in the garden.
questions.explanation: “Although”表示让步，意为“虽然下雨，我们仍然会在花园工作”。
questions.evidence: Although none of us are professional builders, we can watch online videos and learn.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: We need to leave now, ___ we will miss the bus.
questions.explanation: “so”表示结果，意为“我们现在必须离开，否则会错过公交车”。
questions.evidence: The tap is far from the garden, so we have to carry water in buckets.

questions.prompt: Which sentence shows the lowest possibility?
options: We might go to the garden tomorrow.
We may go to the garden tomorrow.
We can go to the garden tomorrow.
We will go to the garden tomorrow.
answers: We might go to the garden tomorrow.
questions.explanation: “might”表示可能性较低，语气最不确定。
questions.evidence: The council might say no because of safety rules.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: ___ we get permission, we cannot build the shed.
questions.explanation: “Unless”表示“除非”，意为“除非我们得到许可，否则不能建棚子”。
questions.evidence: unless we get permission from the council, we can't put a large tank there.
